decisions.reason: As a newly launched ID-vault feature that fits the firm's secure identity ecosystem for regulated clients, it is more likely to be retained and integrated further than withdrawn quickly.
An identity-bound payment wallet matches the firm's super-app and trusted-digital-service strategy, so despite competitive pressure it is strategically worth keeping.

The NFC-tag login authenticator is the most niche and less obviously central software-platform component, making it the likeliest candidate to be discontinued to free resources for broader platform products.
A secure payment and wallet framework sits close to the firm's core payments, identity and platform capabilities and was given dedicated presentation, indicating ongoing commitment.
This is the firm's flagship direction and directly represents its push toward secure multi-service super-app ecosystems, so withdrawal within a year is very unlikely.

An application-shielding security library leverages the firm's long-standing security expertise and supports enterprise-grade trust across its broader offering, so it is likely to remain on the market.
